title: Vendedor(a) Externo - Pronta Entrega - temporário - Obrigatório CNH C, D ou E
description:
Na PepsiCo estamos comprometidos em atrair os melhores talentos, pessoas movidas a desafios e inspiradas por oportunidades de crescimento pessoal e profissional. Somos centrados em nossos clientes e consumidores, para assim alcançar resultados ao fazer negócios da forma correta, agindo com integridade, de forma ágil e responsável.

Somos a PepsiCo:

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa estar em uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com produtos que são apreciados mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia, por consumidores de mais de 200 países, e que está engajada em ajudar a construir um sistema alimentar mais sustentável.

No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo conta com marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®️, TODDY®️, TODDYNHO®️, ELMA CHIPS®️, RUFFLES®️, DORITOS®️, CHEETOS®️, FANDANGOS®️, EQLIBRI™️, GATORADE®️, KERO COCO®️, H2OH!®️, PEPSI®️ entre outras.

A PepsiCo é uma empresa que oferece oportunidades únicas e contrata pessoas qualificadas e diversas, independente de sexo, raça, identidade de gênero, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência. Aqui você encontra um time diverso, formado por pessoas únicas, livres para ser quem são, movidas a desafios em um ambiente dinâmico, que buscam crescimento profissional e são inspiradas por nossa missão de Criar Mais Sorrisos a Cada Gole e a Cada Mordida .

Somos motivados(as) a inovar e desenvolver produtos de qualidade para diversas ocasiões de consumo, guiados(as) sempre por sete comportamentos: Foco no Consumidor, Agir como Dono, Focar e Fazer Acontecer com Rapidez, Expressar opinião sem medo, Elevar o nível do talento e da diversidade, Celebrar o sucesso e Agir com integridade.

Saiba mais sobre nossa cultura e vida na PepsiCo:

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Responsável pelas negociações, vendas e entregas das linhas de produtos PepsiCo definidos para o seu canal de atuação, dentro da máxima disciplina na execução dos padrões e políticas da companhia: fiscal, financeiro, contábil e comercial.
  • Responsável por garantir o atingimento/superação dos objetivos de vendas, respeitando a política comercial e mantendo o crescimento sustentável de sua rota. Utilizar o veículo disponibilizado pela empresa, bem como garantir a sua melhor condução e preservação, de acordo com as leis de trânsito vigentes e políticas da Cia.
  • Responsável pela utilização e manuseio do coletor de dados, de acordo com a orientação da empresa.

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência na área de Vendas, preferencialmente em Bens de Consumo.
  • CNH categoria , C , D OU E.
  • Residir na região de Jaragua, Corupa, Guaramirim, Jaragua do Sul/SC

O que você pode esperar de nós :

  • Um ambiente de trabalho híbrido que promove um equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional;
  • Uma cultura dinâmica e inclusiva;
  • Uma equipe de apoio que irá encorajar o seu crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com projetos relevantes e impactantes para o negócio;

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  1. Desenvolver e manter aplicações web escaláveis utilizando Python (FastAPI) no back-end e React com TypeScript no front-end, garantindo alta performance e confiabilidade em ambientes industriais.
  2. Projetar e otimizar bancos de dados relacionais com SQL, assegurando integridade, eficiência nas consultas e suporte a grandes volumes de dados operacionais e geoespaciais.
  3. Integrar sistemas de monitoramento e análise de dados de produção e sensores de campo, criando APIs robustas que permitam o fluxo contínuo de informações em tempo real.
  4. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, geociência, operações) para traduzir requisitos técnicos complexos em soluções de software eficazes e seguras.
  5. Definir padrões de qualidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento, realizando revisões de código (code reviews), automação de testes e versionamento de projetos via Git.
  6. Conduzir iniciativas de arquitetura e modernização de sistemas legados, adotando tecnologias modernas e metodologias ágeis para aumentar a eficiência e a manutenibilidade.
  7. Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho das aplicações, aplicando métricas, logs e ferramentas de observabilidade para garantir estabilidade em ambientes críticos de operação.

O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado para conversação
  • Python com FastAPI
  • React com Typescript
  • SQL
  • Git

Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Technical Project Manager - Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.
  • Work with Nokia network elements and third-party systems including CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, and CSD .
  • Troubleshoot and optimize signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, and S7 .
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions aligned with customer and Nokia objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and project risks effectively.
  • Provide deep analytical support and troubleshoot complex network issues.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile network technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), fixed and converged networks.
  • Experience with virtualization and container platforms ( Nokia CBIS , Docker , Kubernetes , NCS ).
  • Familiarity with Nokia network components ( CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, CSD ) and third-party solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, Diameter, and S7 protocols.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to meet technical and business goals.
  • Excellent risk management, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting aptitude.
  • Proficiency in English.

P

referred Qualifications

  • Certifications or relevant education in Telecommunications, Networking, or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with Nokia systems and large-scale network deployments.

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.

Principais Atribuições:

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.

  • Avaliar e propor fontes alternativas de abastecimento, contribuindo para a elaboração de soluções técnicas e planos de investimento de capital (CAPEX);

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Ambiental, Sanitária, Hídrica, Civil;

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at

Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.

Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.

Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Analista de Compliance Pleno
description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

1. PLD/AML (Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento do Terrorismo)

• Monitoramento e análise de transações financeiras suspeitas.

• Implementação, revisão e manutenção de políticas e procedimentos de PLD/AML.

• Análise de perfis e comportamentos financeiros para identificar padrões de lavagem de dinheiro.

• Envio de comunicações obrigatórias para órgãos reguladores (ex: COAF no Brasil).

• Uso de ferramentas de busca de informações e procedimentos de due diligence para verificação de clientes e parceiros de negócios.

• Realização de treinamentos internos para conscientização sobre lavagem de dinheiro.

2. Background Check de Clientes e Fornecedores

• KYC (Know Your Customer): Avaliação de informações e histórico para verificação de identidade, entre outras informações, origem de recursos e reputação do cliente.

• KYS (Know Your Supplier): Análise de dados, impedimentos, avaliação da idoneidade e conformidade de fornecedores e terceiros.

• Consulta a listas restritivas e de sanções (OFAC, ONU, BACEN, entre outras).

• Investigação de conflitos de interesse e riscos de fraude.

• Avaliação de propriedade real (Beneficial Ownership) para identificar beneficiários finais de empresas.

3. Monitoramento e Investigações Internas

• Acompanhamento de indicadores de compliance e identificação de desvios de conduta, financeira entre outras não conformidades.

• Investigação de denúncias internas e análise de comportamentos suspeitos, identificando prováveis descumprimento de políticas internas.

• Atuar nas reclamações recebidas através do canal denúncias, averiguando a veracidade e as informações recebidas, sugerindo uma ação para adequação das regras éticas, convívio e de bom comportamento na empresa.

• Aplicação de auditorias e revisões periódicas nos processos internos.

4. Relatórios e Comunicação com Órgãos Reguladores

• Elaboração de relatórios ou apresentações periódicas para utilização interna ou externa da empresa, apresentando os apontamentos recebidos, bem como o plano de ação adotado.

• Comunicação de operações suspeitas para entidades reguladoras.

• Manutenção de registros e documentação de compliance.

5. Atualização Regulatória e Treinamentos

• Acompanhamento das emissões e/ou mudanças nas novas regulamentações na legislação, avaliando e definindo junto as áreas envolvidas o cumprimento e as ações necessárias para manter a empresa compliance com as regulamentações.

• Treinamento contínuo de funcionários para garantir a conformidade.

• Desenvolvimento e atualização dos manuais de compliance, acompanhamento dos vencimentos das políticas, atuando junto as áreas para garantir a conformidade e adequação as regras definidas.

• Apoiar na execução dos trabalhos planejados, emitindo diagnósticos, avaliando a eficiência e eficácia do ambiente de controles dos processos auditados.

Nosso propósito é ajudar organizações a construir ecossistemas de dados que conectam estratégia, tecnologia e marketing , transformando dados em valor de negócio real.

Gestão de Projetos e Entregas

Impacto de Negócio

  • Entender profundamente as dores e oportunidades dos clientes, traduzindo-as em roadmaps de Data Marketing com ROI mensurável.

Impacto Interno e Externo

Formação: Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Comunicação, Ciência da Computação, Estatística ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Marketing, Data Analytics ou Gestão de Negócios será considerado um diferencial. Experiencia em:

Conhecimento em:

  • Ecossistemas e plataformas de MarTech (ex: Google Marketing Platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Databricks, Treasure Data, GA4, etc.).
  • Arquitetura e governança de dados para marketing (consentimento, taxonomia, tagging, integrações).

Preferred Experience

  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer with strong Azure and DevOps experience to design, deploy, and support data infrastructure for our retail applications.   • Strong SQL and data integration experience (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS) OR similar BI reporting tools .
  • Proficiency in Python and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with Terraform , Azure DevOps , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Knowledge of containerization ( Docker/Kubernetes ) and infrastructure automation.
  • Familiar with cloud security and disaster recovery practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or Azure Solutions Architect.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) is a plus.
  • Experience in the retail energy (power & gas) industry is an advantage.

title: Engenheiro de software líder
description:

Procuramos alguém comprometido com a excelência, ademais:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ( Scrum , Kanban ) e ferramentas como Jira .

title: Apparel Designer
description:
Job Title: Apparel Designer

Permanent Remote | Part-time

Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.

We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. If you thrive in both concept development and technical garment execution, this is the opportunity for you.

This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing
  • Select fabrics, trims, and color palettes that bring each collection to life while ensuring comfort, softness, and safety for babies
  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle

What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer

Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.

Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:

We process animal by-products from slaughterhouses into high-quality food materials and raw materials for the pharmaceutical industry. Our products are 100% natural and, due to the knowledge and skills of our employees, of a very high and consistent quality. We strive to outdo ourselves every day.

About the role

Manage and coordinate the company's human resources function across subfunctions, such as recruitment, training and talent development, compensation and benefits, organization development, and employee relations, to meet company’s business requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the formation of one or more elements of functional strategy through specialist expertise and insights, to ensure that the strategy meets business needs.
  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
  • Deliver complex analyses of HR data; identify key trends and contribute to the creation of HR insights that enable the diagnosis of business issues, enhancement of employee engagement, and/or improvement of business performance.
  • Implement HR frameworks and tools for recruitment, performance management, development, career and succession planning, compensation and benefits, diversity, employee onboarding and offboarding, and retention of talent, within an area of expertise, to meet business or institution needs and enable the attraction, development, and retention of talent at a sustainable cost. Ensure compliance with specified design principles, internal policies, and external legal requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice on the interpretation and application of policies and procedures, resolving queries and issues and referring very complex or contentious issues to others.
  • Communicate the local action plan; explain how this relates to the function's strategy and action plan and to the broader organization's mission and vision; motivate people to achieve local business goals.
  • Help develop procedures for an area of the organization and monitor their implementation.
  • Deliver a budget for an area of the organization or conduct complex analyses on budget progress in other areas of the organization.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of HR data collection forms or questionnaires in a specific area of expertise to ensure the collection of relevant data in line with defined requirements.
  • Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
  • Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance. Or manage and report on team performance; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold people accountable for achieving them, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
  • Manage workstreams or small projects within a transformational change program, ensuring integration with related projects; use structured change management methodologies to build acceptance of change and embed desired culture and behaviours.

About you

  • Further/higher education in human resources or business discipline, with 5-8 years prior experience in HR role.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to exercise good judgement
  • A team player with a professional and flexible approach to work.
  • Innovative thinking with a passion to make a difference within the HR team and wider business.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese and Spanish is essential for this role.
  • A solid understanding of current employment law and HR best practice.
  • Flexible with travelling between our four sites (Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina and Chile) is required.

Location Requirement

You must live within commutable distance of our Barreiros, São José - SC, , Brazil office as weekly onsite presence is required.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.

Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

Você separa e combina tarefas em fluxos de trabalho eficientes e simples. Você é decisivo(a) e toma decisões de alta qualidade, mesmo com informações incompletas ou diante da incerteza. Você demonstra uma enorme iniciativa em situações difíceis e é excepcional em identificar e aproveitar oportunidades.

Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. title: Analista de Credito Agro
description:
Título da Vaga: Analista de Crédito Agro e Monitoramento de Carteira

Localização: Remoto

Reporta a: COO (Beatriz Martinez)

A Oportunidade: Seja o Arquiteto do Risco na Vanguarda da Transformação do Agro

Na AgDev, não apenas financiamos o agronegócio brasileiro; nós catalisamos sua transformação. Com crédito regenerativo, estruturado e acessível, nossa missão é viabilizar a expansão da produção agrícola sobre pastagens degradadas, combatendo o desmatamento e construindo um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso time de Risco de Crédito é o guardião da nossa tese de investimento. Somos responsáveis por construir um portfólio de crédito que seja, ao mesmo tempo, resiliente, rentável e transformador, garantindo a confiança do capital que financia a agricultura do futuro.

Procuramos um profissional que transcenda a análise tradicional. Alguém que não apenas avalie o risco, mas que o modele. Que não apenas utilize ferramentas de IA, mas que seja um parceiro intelectual na sua evolução, escalando nossa capacidade de tomar decisões de crédito mais inteligentes e rápidas.

Sua Missão nos Primeiros 12 Meses

Seu sucesso será medido pela sua capacidade de atuar com excelência na análise de novas operações e no monitoramento rigoroso da carteira, entregando resultados concretos:

  • Análise de Risco Estratégica: Estruturar e defender no Comitê de Crédito um pipeline de operações alinhadas à tese de investimento dos nossos veículos FIDC e CRA, contribuindo diretamente para a meta de alocação de capital da companhia.
  • Monitoramento de Portfólio 360°: Garantir a saúde e a performance de 100% da carteira ativa, através de um sistema de monitoramento proativo que antecipe riscos e assegure o cumprimento rigoroso de todos os covenants financeiros e, crucialmente, ESG.
  • Eficiência e Automação: Liderar a frente de otimização de processos na esteira de crédito, colaborando com a equipe de IA para atingir 80% de automação, liberando tempo da equipe para análises mais estratégicas e aumentando o throughput de operações.
  • Reporting e Governança: Assegurar 100% de acuracidade e pontualidade nos relatórios de risco para o Comitê de Crédito, Diretoria e investidores dos nossos fundos.
Responsabilidades-Chave

1. Análise e Estruturação de Crédito ( Underwriting )

  • Analisar demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, Fluxo de Caixa) de grandes produtores rurais e grupos econômicos.
  • Modelar a capacidade de pagamento e o fluxo de caixa dos projetos, considerando cenários de estresse de produtividade e preço de commodities.
  • Analisar a estrutura de garantias (imóveis rurais, CPRs, etc.) em colaboração com a equipe Jurídica para garantir a robustez e exequibilidade.
  • Realizar diligência completa utilizando ferramentas de mercado (ex: AgRisk, Serasa, JusBrasil) e fontes de dados alternativas.
  • Elaborar pareceres de crédito ( Investment Memos ) detalhados, com análise profunda de riscos e mitigantes, para apresentação e defesa no Comitê de Crédito.

2. Gestão de Portfólio e Monitoramento

  • Acompanhar a saúde financeira dos produtores da carteira através de relatórios periódicos e análises de safra.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento de covenants socioambientais, utilizando ferramentas de sensoriamento remoto e outras tecnologias para verificar a aderência às práticas de agricultura regenerativa acordadas.
  • Identificar sinais de alerta precoce ( early warning signs ) e propor ações proativas de mitigação de risco.
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de recebimento e liberação de garantias conforme a amortização das operações.

3. Estratégia de Risco e Inovação em IA

  • Auxiliar na definição e aprimoramento contínuo das políticas de crédito da AgDev.
  • Atuar como product owner do ponto de vista de Risco no desenvolvimento e backtesting de modelos de IA, fornecendo feedback contínuo para a equipe de tecnologia.
  • Manter o CRM (Pipedrive) e outros sistemas atualizados com o status de risco e as informações relevantes de cada operação. 17
Perfil Ideal
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 2-3 anos com análise de crédito e risco no agronegócio. Experiência em bancos, fundos (FIDC), securitizadoras ou agfintechs é fortemente preferencial. Experiência comprovada com a análise de crédito para grandes produtores rurais e grupos econômicos complexos.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Domínio profundo de análise financeira, contabilidade rural e modelagem. Domínio da estrutura e do fluxo operacional de instrumentos de dívida do agronegócio, especialmente FIDC e CRA.
  • Análise fundiário-ambiental de imóveis rurais: familiaridade com análise de imóveis rurais.
  • Garantias: Familiaridade avançada com os principais instrumentos de crédito e garantias do agro (CPR-F, Alienação Fiduciária de Imóvel Rural, Hipoteca Rural).
  • Ferramentas: Experiência prática com ferramentas de análise de risco (ex: AgRisk), Excel avançado e CRM (Pipedrive é um diferencial). Familiaridade com plataformas de sensoriamento remoto é um grande diferencial.
  • Mentalidade de IA: Entusiasmo e curiosidade para usar, testar e ajudar a construir tecnologia de ponta para escalar e aprimorar processos de risco.
Soft Skills Essenciais
  • Ownership (Dono): Tratar o portfólio de crédito como seu próprio capital, sentindo-se pessoalmente responsável pela sua performance e resiliência.
  • Proatividade e Autonomia: Antecipar necessidades, iniciar ações e resolver problemas com independência, colaborando intensamente com equipes multidisciplinares (Comercial, Jurídico, IA).
  • Comunicação Clara: Capacidade de sintetizar análises complexas em recomendações claras, objetivas e defensáveis para uma audiência sênior (C-level e investidores).
  • Resiliência: Lidar bem com a pressão e a complexidade de múltiplas operações simultâneas, mantendo um alto padrão de qualidade e atenção aos detalhes.
Por que a AgDev?
  • Impacto: Atuação direta na promoção da agricultura regenerativa e na redução do desmatamento, gerando valor ambiental e financeiro.
  • Tecnologia: Time ágil, com uso intensivo de tecnologia e IA para escalar o impacto, reduzir a burocracia e tomar decisões mais inteligentes.
  • Cultura de Alta Performance: Um ambiente que combina agilidade de startup com a disciplina de uma gestora de ativos. Utilizamos metodologias como Scaling Up e 3HAG para garantir um crescimento estruturado.
  • Exposição a Capital Internacional: Oportunidade única de trabalhar na estruturação de operações financiadas por investidores globais.
  • Crescimento: Oportunidades reais de crescimento e aprendizado contínuo em um modelo de negócio disruptivo e em rápida expansão.
  • Time: Equipe sênior, experiente e altamente colaborativa, com uma cultura digital e direta.
Próximos Passos

Se você acredita que crédito, tecnologia e sustentabilidade podem transformar o agronegócio e quer liderar essa revolução, envie seu currículo e um breve parágrafo descrevendo um exemplo de uma operação de crédito agro complexa que você analisou, destacando os principais riscos e as mitigantes que você estruturou.

title: Smartsheet Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: Smartsheet Solution Architect

Location: Remote in LATAM (EST time zone required)

Duration: 6-12 months

Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and certified Smartsheet Solution Architect & PMO Leader to drive the strategic design, implementation, and optimization of our work management and Project Portfolio Management (PPM) solutions. This is a critical leadership role for an individual who not only understands Smartsheet at an architectural level but can also establish and mature enterprise-wide Project Management Office (PMO) standards and capabilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong eye for design and user experience, able to provide expert guidance on sheet layout, structure, and visual presentation to ensure optimal usability and engagement.Key Responsibilities

Smartsheet Architecture & Development

  • Design and Architect Solutions: Lead the end-to-end architectural design and development of complex, integrated Smartsheet solutions, including utilizing premium applications like Control Center, Resource Management, and Dynamic View, to meet Gordian's strategic business needs.
  • Platform Optimization: Act as the Smartsheet expert and Administrator , continuously optimizing the platform for performance, scalability, and user experience.
  • Governance and Standards: Establish and enforce Smartsheet governance, best practices, and standardization for dashboards, reporting, automation, and data integrity across the organization.
  • Stakeholder Mobilization: Introduce and drive adoption of the Smartsheet platform and its capabilities across all levels of company leadership.
  • Design Excellence: Provide expert consultation on the visual design and structural layout of sheets , dashboards, and reports, ensuring they are intuitive, aesthetically pleasing, and aligned with user experience best practices. Project & Program Management Office (PMO) Leadership
  • PMO Implementation: Establish, lead, and mature the PMO function —defining, documenting, and implementing project management standards, best practices, and procedures (PMP methodologies).
  • PPM Tool Implementation: Establish and lead the use of Smartsheetas the primary PPM tool for enterprise-wide intake, demand, and resource management, portfolio management, and real-time status reporting.
  • Strategic Alignment: Charter and lead executive-level bodies, such as a Steering Committee or Project Review Board (PRB), to ensure project and program portfolios are aligned with strategic goals and organizational objectives.
  • Process Improvement: Drive measurable improvements in project delivery metrics, such as increasing on-time completion rates and enhancing strategic focus through effective prioritization methods.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience

  • Progressive leadership experience in Project Management, Program Management, and/or PMO Director roles.
  • Expert-level experience in Smartsheet development, configuration, and administration, with a proven track record of implementing the platform in multiple corporate environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in establishing, leading, and maturing a corporate PMO from the ground up, including hiring and managing a team of Project Managers, Business Analysts, and Scrum Masters.
  • Experience managing multiple project portfolios (e.g., infrastructure, application development) valued over $10M each and managing over 300 concurrent projects.
  • Experience in change management and successfully integrating new processes and teams following acquisitions or mergers.
  • Design sensibility and UX expertise with the ability to evaluate and provide constructive feedback on sheet design, layout optimization, color schemes, formatting, and overall visual presentation to enhance usability and user adoption.

Certifications

  • Smartsheet Solution Architect Certified (Essential)
  • Smartsheet Certified Solution Consultant (Highly preferred)
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) (Essential)
  • Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) (Preferred)
  • Certified Agile Practitioner (PMI-ACP) (Preferred)

Education & Logistics

  • Education: Master’s degree in project management or a related field is highly desirable
  • Work Hours: This role will primarily operate on Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours to align with company operations.
  • Location: Remote

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Location: Sao Jose Dos Campos, Brazil

About the Opportunity:

Join Modirum | Gespi's exciting new venture! We are establishing a dedicated development team to adapt our proven, existing technologies for innovative customers in the UAV Defence sector. As a Solution Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing robust, scalable, and secure system architectures that leverage our core technology while meeting the unique and demanding requirements of the defence industry. You will be instrumental in translating complex requirements into technical blueprints for the development teams.

Your Role in the Team:

As the Solution Architect, you are crucial for defining the technical foundation of our defence solutions. You will:

* Design end-to-end system architectures, ensuring they align with both business needs and the capabilities of our existing technology stack.

* Analyze technical requirements from the defence sector and propose optimal architectural solutions.

* Collaborate closely with the Engineering lead, Product Owner, and development leads (AI, UX, Backend, Hardware) to ensure architectural integrity and feasibility.

* Document architectural decisions, patterns, and guidelines for the development teams.

* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and frameworks suitable for defence applications.

* Identify potential technical risks and propose mitigation strategies.

* Ensure the designed solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable.

* Contribute directly to the team's ability to deliver effective and reliable solutions for our defence customers.

Qualifications:

* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or a similar senior technical design role.

* Deep understanding of software architecture principles, patterns (e.g., microservices, event-driven), and best practices.

* Experience designing complex, distributed systems.

* Ability to analyze requirements and translate them into technical designs.

* Strong understanding of system integration, APIs, and data modeling.

* Excellent technical documentation and communication skills.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) is often beneficial.

* Good understanding robotics architecture.

Bonus Points:

* Experience designing solutions for Defence, Aerospace, or high-security environments.

* Experience adapting existing platforms or products for new verticals.

* Knowledge of specific defence standards or security protocols.

* Background in software development.

What We Offer:

* An opportunity to design critical system architectures for a high-impact venture.

* A key role in adapting proven technology for the demanding UAV Defence market.

* Competitive salary and benefits package.

* A collaborative environment focused on technical excellence.

title: Analista de processos e auditoria - CX pos venda
description:
AUDITOR(A) CX — CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

Local: Americana/SP (presencial)

Departamento: Experiência do Cliente / Comercial / Operações

Modelo: Startup / Scale-up em crescimento nacional

SOBRE A CARDSINOVA

Somos uma startup de tecnologia e educação corporativa que nasceu como certificadora digital e evoluiu para um ecossistema completo de soluções para contabilidades — com foco em crescimento, dados e cultura empreendedora.

A CardsInova está em ritmo acelerado de expansão e busca profissionais com mentalidade analítica, foco em excelência e desejo de impactar a experiência dos nossos clientes e parceiros.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir a qualidade e consistência da experiência do cliente (CX) em todas as fases da jornada — desde o onboarding até a renovação — auditando processos, comunicações e entregas realizadas pelos times de CS (Customer Success), Comercial e Atendimento .

O Auditor CX é o guardião da experiência do cliente: identifica falhas, mensura padrões de qualidade, propõe melhorias e garante que cada parceiro CardsInova se sinta valorizado e bem atendido.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
  • Auditar os processos de onboarding, acompanhamento e pós-venda .
  • Avaliar comunicações enviadas pelos times de CS, Comercial e Suporte Técnico , garantindo padronização e clareza.
  • Realizar testes de cliente oculto (via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail) para medir qualidade e tempo de resposta.
  • Verificar o envio correto dos relatórios mensais de desempenho e indicadores aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar bases de clientes e cruzar informações entre CRM , Asana e Ovo.
  • Elaborar relatórios quinzenais de auditoria , com indicadores, não conformidades e sugestões de melhoria.
  • Apoiar as lideranças na padronização de processos e na construção de uma cultura de excelência no atendimento.
  • Atuar de forma preventiva, resolvendo gargalos antes que cheguem ao Head Comercial ou à Diretoria.
INDICADORES DE DESEMPENHO (KPIs)
  • ≥ 90% de conformidade nos processos auditados.
  • ≤ 2h de tempo médio de resposta ao cliente.
  • ≥ 85% de clientes satisfeitos (CSAT).
  • ≥ 70 pontos no NPS médio trimestral.
  • 100% de relatórios e auditorias entregues dentro do prazo.
REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS
  • Formação em Administração, Gestão da Qualidade, Processos, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com Customer Success, atendimento, auditoria de processos ou controle de qualidade .
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas digitais (CRM, planilhas, Asana, Google Workspace).
  • Habilidade em leitura e análise de dados e indicadores.
  • Capacidade de redigir relatórios claros, com visão crítica e embasamento.
COMPETÊNCIAS E PERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL
  • Visão sistêmica: entende como o comercial, CS e suporte se conectam na jornada do cliente.
  • Perfil analítico: busca causas e não apenas sintomas.
  • Comunicação empática e diplomática: sabe cobrar com respeito e contribuir para melhoria contínua.
  • Maturidade emocional: atua de forma imparcial e profissional, mesmo em situações de conflito.
  • Organização e autonomia: consegue gerenciar prazos e demandas sem supervisão constante.
  • Mentalidade de crescimento: enxerga a auditoria como ferramenta de evolução, não de punição.
O QUE OFERECEMOS
  • Salário fixo
  • Cartão Flash de alimentação/refeição
  • Totalpass (academia e bem-estar)
  • Telemedicina, Telenutrição e Telepsicologia
POR QUE SER AUDITOR CX NA CARDSINOVA

Porque aqui você não vai apenas avaliar processos — vai elevar o padrão de experiência do cliente em uma das startups mais promissoras do setor contábil.

Seu olhar atento e analítico será o motor que conecta excelência operacional, encantamento do cliente e crescimento escalável.

Assunto: Auditor CX CardsInova 2025

Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo “pague o que usar”, compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!

O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e de aprendizado constante. #VemSerKover!

Ser Kover é sinônimo de ser super engajado quando o assunto é desafio. Amamos pessoas que se importam com outras pessoas, que tenham brilho nos olhos e vontade de sobra para mudar o mundo. Se você acredita em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover! ♥

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escala 100% presencial;

  • Desejável experiência prévia em Vendas ou Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Google Workspace;
  • Conhecimento das ferramentas e sistemas de CRM;
  • Ter boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Atenção ao detalhes;
  • Proatividade;
  • Empatia para entender as necessidades dos clientes;
  • Capacidade de escuta ativa;
  • Persuasão e Negociação;
  • Foco em resultados;
  • Adaptabilidade.

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

Seguro de Vida: Para cuidarmos do nosso bem maior: nossos Kovers.

Plano de Saúde: É importante se cuidar e estar bem.

Plano Odontológico: Para você dar aquele sorrisão bonito!

Cartão Flash: Seu VR e/ou VA em um único cartão! Até porque como diz o ditado: “saco vazio não para em pé!”

Parceria com SESC: Adesão ao benefício depois de 90 dias de contrato.

Vale-Transporte ou Vale-Combustível: A escolha de como você se move é só sua.

Seja um Kover e venha transformar vidas através da mobilidade

Sobre a Kovi

Na Kovi, acreditamos que mobilidade muda direções. Nascemos em 2018 com um propósito claro: criar oportunidades para que todos possam dirigir suas vidas. Hoje, somos referência em oferecer soluções inovadoras para clientes, promovendo inclusão financeira e autonomia para quem movimenta as cidades.

Mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia, somos um time apaixonado por impacto real. Aqui, combinamos dados, empatia e ousadia para criar um ecossistema justo, sustentável e acessível. E isso é só o começo.

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:

You will play a crucial role in building intuitive, responsive, and robust user interfaces for our defence solutions, translating complex requirements and designs into high-quality code.

Qualifications:

* Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and CSS preprocessors (e.g., SASS, LESS).

* Strong understanding of front-end architecture, state management, and component-based design.

* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and asynchronous request handling.

* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

Bonus Points:

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

What We Offer:

* A senior role in a new team adapting proven technology for a dynamic market.

* Work on technically challenging front-end development projects.

* Collaboration with UX designers, backend engineers, and AI specialists.

* Competitive salary and benefits package.

* An environment that values technical excellence and collaboration.

title: Masters / PHD In Science
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Science with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Analista Gestão de Pessoas Sr.
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Objetivo do cargo:

Atrair, identificar e selecionar os melhores talentos para atender às demandas operacionais e estratégicas da Diretoria de Logística, atuando de forma alinhada às políticas de Recursos Humanos e às diretrizes organizacionais, garantindo a eficiência dos processos seletivos e contribuindo para a formação de equipes qualificadas e alinhadas à cultura da empresa.

Requisitos do Cargo

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Psicologia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência:

  • Vivência sólida na área de Atração e Seleção.
  • Experiência comprovada em técnicas de entrevista por competência e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental.
