title: Solutions and Implementation Engineer
description:
About Us

At Qase, we’re building a better testing management platform for teams to streamline their QA processes and achieve faster releases. We’re looking for a versatile Solutions and Implementation Engineer to play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between our product, sales, and customers—driving adoption, solving problems, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

As a fast-paced and growing startup, we move quickly and adapt often. The responsibilities outlined below reflect the current needs of the business, but may evolve over time as priorities shift and new challenges arise. Flexibility, initiative, and a willingness to adapt are key to success in this role.

We’re seeking someone who can align part of their schedule with early Eastern Standard Time (EST) working hours. 

What You'll Do Pre-Sales Responsibilities:
  • Assist Enterprise Account Executives with technical discovery calls to understand customer pain points, business outcomes, and technical requirements.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations that align with client use cases.
  • Manage Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) to validate product fit, including test data setup, integrations, and success criteria validation.
  • Provide technical input for RFP/RFI responses and proposals, highlighting implementation feasibility and scalability.
  • Independently complete security questionnaires for customers and prospects.
Post-Sales Responsibilities:
  • Own end-to-end customer onboarding: Design, scope and execute implementation plans, including integrations and complex data migrations.
  • Lead deployment activities: environment setup, infrastructure configuration, and UAT coordination.
  • Build customer implementation playbooks , timelines, and success metrics, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point during implementations, troubleshooting issues across APIs, authentication, and infrastructure.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions for admins, QA engineers, and developers to ensure adoption and operational excellence.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for escalations, offering creative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities based on customer feedback and usage.
  • Create and deploy customized training sessions for new customers.
Technical Responsibilities:
  • Hands-on engineering: ability to write and iterate complex scripts, troubleshoot issues, sample code, and support integrations to accelerate adoption.
  • System design & Architecture: design and communicate solution architectures, including setting up AWS infrastructure, deploying instances, and defining infrastructure costs for customers or prospects.
  • Security & Compliance: confidently address customer and prospect security requirements by completing questionnaires, explaining our security posture, and ensuring trust in our practices.
  • Technical Documentation: create and maintain clear, reusable technical documentation such as integration guides, architecture diagrams, and solution playbooks.
Collaboration & Optimization:
  • Act as the bridge between customers and internal teams, relaying actionable feedback to improve the product.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth customer lifecycles.
  • Monitor customer usage trends and offer strategies to optimize value.
What You’ll Bring Core Skills: Technical Expertise:
  • Knowledge of QA processes and Test Management Systems (TMS) platforms, including APIs, CI/CD, and issue trackers.
  • Strong coding/scripting skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript).
  • Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) for deployments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Customer-Facing Skills:
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and consultative skills.
  • Strong organizational skills for managing parallel implementation projects.
Problem-Solving:
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting technical issues and proposing creative, customer-focused solutions.
Experience:
  • 3+ years in implementation engineering, solutions engineering or technical account management in a SaaS environment. Preferred experience in a technical/engineering background who transitioned to customer facing responsibilities. Also considering candidates with 3+ years as an QA automation architect or engineer with strong customer facing experience. 
  • Background in Quality Assurance or certifications in cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, etc.).
  • Experience managing the customer lifecycle, from onboarding to renewal.
Tools You’ll Use:
  • CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Collaboration tools like JIRA, Postman, or other API testing/reporting tools.
Soft Skills We Value:
  • Collaboration: Work seamlessly across teams and communicate with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in fast-paced environments with multiple ongoing engagements.
  • Empathy: A customer-first mindset with a genuine desire to help clients succeed.
Key Deliverables:
  • Deliver smooth, on-time customer implementations and migrations.
  • Drive faster time-to-value for customers through structured, seamless onboarding.
  • Shorten sales cycles with impactful technical demos.
  • Reduce churn by offering exceptional post-sales support.
  • Provide actionable feedback to the Product team to enhance the platform.

Join us at Qase and be part of a dynamic team driving the future of test management!

Capacidade de definir e acompanhar métricas de produto (KPIs, OKRs).

Mentalidade empreendedora e builder — foco em resolver problemas, testar hipóteses e colocar produtos no ar.

Senso de dono e autonomia: age como responsável pelo sucesso do produto.

Tomada de decisão baseada em dados, sem perder sensibilidade para contexto e experiência do usuário.

Comunicação clara, estruturada e influente, com diferentes níveis da organização. Empatia e colaboração com design, engenharia e áreas de negócio.

Capacidade de priorização e resiliência em contextos de alta velocidade e incerteza.

Pensamento estratégico e pragmatismo — equilibra visão de longo prazo com entregas de curto prazo.

Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo, sempre em busca de novas abordagens e ferramentas.

Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Design, Ciência da Computação, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável certificação ou especialização em Gestão de Produtos Digitais, Lean Product Management, ou Agile Product Ownership.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization.   • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Competências desejadas:

title: Trainee em Mercado Financeiro
description:
SOBRE O CLUBE DO VALOR:

O Clube do Valor foi fundado em 2015 com o objetivo de mudar, de verdade, a relação do brasileiro com o dinheiro. Com o passar do tempo, acertamos, erramos e aprendemos muito. Entendemos que, pra gente, o que importa mesmo são duas coisas: propósito (o que nos move) e cultura (o que somos e como agimos).

Nosso propósito é ambicioso: levar tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros, para que cada um possa viver a vida dos seus sonhos. Para nos aproximarmos do nosso propósito, atuamos em duas frentes complementares: educação e gestão de investimentos. Já impactamos mais de 40 mil brasileiros com nossos conteúdos e ultrapassamos a marca de 4,7 bilhões de patrimônio sob aconselhamento.

NOSSOS VALORES:

Nosso conjunto de valores reflete o que é empreender e ser um sócio que gera VALOR para o CDV:

V alorizamos resultados, trabalho inteligente e duro;

A ssumimos o protagonismo do nosso crescimento;

L evamos integridade e transparência em tudo o que fazemos;

O bstinados em superar as expectativas de todos os Clubistas (clientes e audiência);

R econhecemos de forma meritocrática quem age como dono.

O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ

Ensino superior ou técnico cursando/completo (qualquer curso);

Bom domínio da língua portuguesa, escrita e comunicação em geral;

Interesse/conhecimento mínimo sobre investimentos e finanças pessoais;

Abertura a desenvolvimento;

Perfil comercial e analítico;

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

Residência em Porto Alegre/Região.

SOBRE A VAGA

O Clube do Valor oferece um Programa de Formação de Planejadores Financeiros (PFP) estruturado em cinco fases. Ao longo dessa jornada, você passará por uma imersão intensiva, desenhada para acelerar o desenvolvimento das suas habilidades comerciais, relacionais e técnicas, por meio de experiências teóricas e práticas. Durante todo o processo, você contará com o apoio da nossa área de Enablement, além do financiamento da certificação CEA oferecido pelo CDV.

Nosso objetivo é que você seja formado para atuar como um Planejador Financeiro, levando tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros.

FASE 1: Onboarding e Foco Institucional

O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua integração na empresa, engajamento com o time, com a nossa cultura e o direcionamento dos seus primeiros passos na trilha de formação.

Seus principais focos serão:

Onboarding Institucional;

Imersão Cultural;

Onboarding de Pré-Vendas.

FASE 2: Máquina de Vendas

Nessa etapa, você será responsável pela qualificação dos investidores, focando no desenvolvimento de habilidades comerciais e geração de novas oportunidades de negócios.

Seus principais focos serão:

Desenvolver habilidades comerciais.

Realizar agendamentos;

Pitch comercial;

Geração de oportunidades;

Foco em resultado e atingimento de metas.

FASE 3: Especialista em Investimentos

O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua capacitação técnica, seja na visão geral do mercado financeiro, investimentos ou operacional.

Seus principais focos serão:

Conhecimento geral sobre o Mercado Financeiro;

Conquista da certificação CEA;

Estudo da Filosofia e Estratégias de Investimentos do CDV;

Conhecimento de BackOffice e Ferramentas Operacionais.

FASE 4: Especialista em Novos Negócios

O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua capacitação para atendimento e relacionamento com o cliente.Você segue se desenvolvendo comercialmente e também aprende a realizar um fechamento comercial e começa a formar sua base de clientes.

Seus principais focos serão:

Jornada e Relacionamento com o Cliente;

Fechamento Comercial;

Elaboração de Planejamento Financeiro.

FASE 5: Jornada do Cliente

O objetivo dessa etapa é seguir a sua capacitação para atendimento e relacionamento com o cliente, desenvolvendo a postura e a conduta de um planejador.

Seus principais focos serão:

Jornada e Relacionamento com o Cliente;

Postura e Conduta do Planejador.

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

SAÚDE

Conexa Saúde: valorizamos o cuidado à saúde mental, por isso, custeamos 4 sessões de terapia/mês.

Plano de Saúde: valorizamos a saúde dos nossos colaboradores! Oferecemos adesão opcional ao plano de saúde Unimed, com custo acessível.

Total Pass: acesso à plataforma exclusiva com treinos, receitas, meditação, desconto em academias, entre outros.

Plano de Saúde Pet (Pet Love): Oferecemos acesso a planos de saúde para pets com condições especiais, garantindo cuidado e proteção para o seu pet. A adesão é opcional.

Seguro de Vida: Oferecemos uma solução personalizada de seguro de vida, com cashback de até 40% no primeiro ano de vigência da apólice.

EDUCAÇÃO E DESENVOLVIMENTO

Certificação de Especialista em Investimentos (CEA): como forma de incentivo, custeamos os seus estudos para a certificação e financiamos a sua prova em caso de aprovação.

BEM ESTAR

Ambiente de Trabalho: acreditamos na autonomia, por isso, nosso ambiente é flexível e apoia o desenvolvimento/crescimento de seus membros. Somos reconhecidos por isso: no Glassdoor, temos 4,7/5 de avaliação e 98% de recomendação entre quem já fez parte do nosso time.

Licenças Maternidade e Paternidade: sabemos que esse é um momento único, por isso, nossos clubistas contam com licenças estendidas.

CRESCIMENTO

Programa de Desenvolvimento de Lideranças (PDL): valorizamos o crescimento interno e a formação de líderes. Nosso PDL é voltado para colaboradores que desejam seguir uma carreira de gestão, oferecendo trilhas de aprendizado, mentorias e desenvolvimento estratégico.

Crescimento: temos um modelo de partnership que possibilita e estimula o crescimento de todos dentro da empresa, inclusive, premiando os melhores membros com a possibilidade de entrada na sociedade.

TRANQUILIDADE FINANCEIRA

Benefícios Multi Flexível: atuamos com o cartão Flash e ele permite que você tenha autonomia de utilizar o seu benefício em diversas frentes como transporte, alimentação, cultura, lazer, entre outros.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Senior Developer (CRM, ERP, & E-commerce)
description:
Location: Remote | Full-Time

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Full Stack Developer with specialized expertise in architecting and building custom integrations between CRM, ERP, and E-Commerce systems, as well as full-stack expertise using modern JavaScript technologies. You’ll play a pivotal role in architecting and implementing data schemas and systems integrations that drive significant business value across our company’s multiple brands. The role specifically requires expertise with Microsoft Dynamics 365, both on-prem and cloud , as well as expertise with more modern and e-commerce related stacks, specifically including HubSpot and Shopify . This role requires strong problem-solving skills, a strong work ethic, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack web applications, including CRM micro-applications and their integrations with other business systems.
  • Integrate and optimize solutions with Microsoft Dynamics 365 tools, including CRM, ERP, Power Automate, and Power BI.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Oversee code quality and ensure best practices are followed throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Deploy and manage applications on relevant cloud infrastructure, ensuring reliability and scalability.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends related to CRM, e-commerce, and enterprise integrations.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Senior Developer with expertise in CRM development and business integrations .
  • Extensive knowledge of the Shopify platform , including custom Shopify development (APIs, Hydrogen, Oxygen, Shopify Apps).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 on-prem and cloud , particularly with on-prem to cloud migrations as well as services like CRM and Power Automate.
  • Extensive knowledge of the HubSpot platform , including custom usage of HubSpot APIs.
  • Proficiency in relevant programming languages (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Python) and frameworks.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot and debug complex systems.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Fluent in English for both verbal and written communication.
  • Experience with various databases and cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure) is a plus.

What Modern.tech Offers

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and shape the future of our web and mobile applications.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment that values creativity and innovation.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities to enhance your skills and expertise.
  • Flexible work hours and remote work options.

If you are a highly motivated and skilled Senior Developer with a passion for building complex integrations and e-commerce solutions, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and be part of an exciting journey in creating innovative and complex systems.

Resumo da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos de TI sênior, com expertise comprovada no Setor de Energia Elétrica, para liderar a execução de projetos tecnológicos estratégicos em um ambiente 100% remoto.

Este profissional será responsável pela gestão completa do ciclo de vida dos projetos (end-to-end), atuando como o principal facilitador entre as equipes técnicas e as unidades de negócio. O objetivo é garantir que as soluções de TI agreguem valor real e atendam às complexas demandas regulatórias e operacionais do setor.

Principais Atribuições e Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Estratégica de Projetos: Liderar o planejamento, execução e monitoramento de projetos de tecnologia, assegurando o cumprimento rigoroso de escopo, prazo e orçamento definidos.
  • Especialista de Domínio (SME): Atuar como a principal interface técnica e de negócios entre as áreas de TI e as operações do setor elétrico, traduzindo requisitos complexos em soluções tecnológicas eficazes e aderentes às especificidades regulatórias.
  • Liderança de Equipes Virtuais: Gerenciar e motivar equipes multidisciplinares e geograficamente distribuídas, fomentando um ambiente de alta performance, colaboração e responsabilidade.
  • Gestão de Stakeholders e Comunicação: Conduzir a gestão de stakeholders em todos os níveis, incluindo a alta administração. Garantir comunicação clara, alinhamento de expectativas e report de status executivo.
  • Governança e Metodologia: Definir e aplicar as metodologias de gestão (Ágil - Scrum/Kanban, Preditiva ou Híbrida) mais adequadas à natureza de cada projeto, em conformidade com as diretrizes do PMO.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Mudanças: Realizar a gestão proativa de riscos, desenvolvendo planos de mitigação e contingência. Gerenciar mudanças de escopo de forma estruturada, avaliando impactos e formalizando aprovações.
  • Controle e Report Executivo: Assegurar a governança e a documentação completa do projeto (termos de abertura, cronogramas, lições aprendidas) e apresentar relatórios de progresso e resultados de forma objetiva à Diretoria.

title: Zootecnista
description:
Zootecnista - Confinamento de Bovinos de Corte

Título da Vaga: Zootecnista - Gestão de Confinamento de Engorda

Local de Trabalho: Monte Alegre de Minas/MG

Modalidade: Presencial | Tempo Integral

A Empresa:

A Green Farming Fazendas Renováveis é uma empresa brasileira especializada na produção de carne de alta qualidade, originária do cruzamento industrial de raças taurinas e zebuínas. Fundada com o objetivo de produzir carne de alto padrão na região do cerrado brasileiro, a empresa tem sede em Monte Alegre de Minas, MG.

Missão do Cargo:

O Zootecnista será o responsável técnico e operacional pela gestão completa do setor de confinamento, garantindo a máxima eficiência produtiva, o bem-estar animal e a qualidade da carne, por meio de um manejo nutricional, sanitário e de gestão de rebanho de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  1. Nutrição e Formulação de Dietas:
  • Formular e ajustar dietas de alto desempenho para as diferentes categorias de bovinos em engorda, visando o melhor custo-benefício e maximização do GPD (Ganho de Peso Diário).
  • Supervisionar e garantir o controle de qualidade e a correta mistura (homogeneidade) da ração na fábrica e nos vagões forrageiros.
  • Realizar a Leitura de Cocho (Escore de Cocho) diária, tomando decisões assertivas sobre o ajuste da quantidade e do tipo de dieta fornecida.
  • Gerenciar o estoque e a qualidade dos insumos (volumosos, concentrados, núcleos, aditivos).
  1. Manejo Zootécnico e Sanitário:
  • Planejar e executar o protocolo de chegada, adaptação e embarque dos animais.
  • Monitorar diariamente o estado de saúde e o bem-estar dos animais, identificando precocemente problemas sanitários e orientando o manejo do curral-hospital (em parceria com Médico Veterinário, se houver).
  • Gerenciar a formação e a lotação dos lotes de animais (separação por peso, sexo, escore corporal e/ou raça).
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de bem-estar animal e biosseguridade.
  1. Gestão de Pessoas e Infraestrutura:
  • Coordenar, treinar e supervisionar a equipe de trato e manejo do confinamento.
  • Garantir a manutenção e a funcionalidade das instalações (currais, cochos, bebedouros, fábrica de ração, pátio de compostagem).
  • Controlar o uso e a manutenção dos maquinários e equipamentos utilizados no manejo da alimentação.
  1. ﻿ Análise de Dados e Resultados:
  • Coletar, registrar e analisar dados de desempenho (Peso de Entrada/Saída, GPD, Conversão Alimentar, Rendimento de Carcaça).
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais de acompanhamento produtivo e financeiro para a diretoria.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão e softwares específicos para otimizar os processos do confinamento.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Zootecnia (Obrigatório).
  • Experiência: Sólida experiência comprovada em Confinamento de Bovinos de Corte (foco em nutrição, manejo de cocho e gestão de equipes).
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:
  • Domínio em formulação de dietas para bovinos de corte.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão agropecuária e planilhas eletrônicas avançadas (Excel).
  • Conhecimento sobre qualidade de grãos e volumosos.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais:
  • Liderança e Habilidade para gestão e treinamento de equipes.
  • Proatividade, senso de urgência e capacidade de tomar decisões rápidas em ambiente de alta pressão.
  • Comprometimento com resultados, bem-estar animal e sustentabilidade.
Diferenciais:
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Nutrição de Ruminantes ou Produção de Bovinos de Corte.
  • Experiência com sistemas de recria intensiva.
Oferecemos:
  • Salário competitivo (a ser negociado)
  • Moradia na fazenda
  • Fazenda próxima da cidade de Monte Alegre de Minas/MG
  • Benefícios adicionais

title: Staff Mobile Engineer
description:
About the job

Location: Hybrid — Curitiba, Brazil (1–2 days/week on-site)

Type: Contract (PJ)

Schedule: Must be available to work US hours (Mountain Standard Time - MST)

About REDX

REDX is a SaaS company that builds prospecting software to help real estate agents and teams grow their business. Our platform offers high-quality lead data, productivity tools. We empower agents to build sustainable, scalable businesses by simplifying the listing process and providing the tools they need to succeed.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Mobile Engineer with deep expertise in Flutter and/or React Native to help lead the architecture, development, and evolution of our mobile applications. You’ll work closely with design, product, and backend teams to deliver high-impact features and ensure seamless performance across platforms.

This role requires someone with a strong foundation in software development (7+ years), with 5+ years specifically in mobile app development , and the ability to lead, mentor, and own projects from conception to production.

What You'll Be Working With

  • Mobile: Flutter, React Native
  • Backend: Node.js, Nest.js, MongoDB, Mongoose
  • Frontend (Web): React, Angular
  • Infrastructure: GCP, AWS, GitHub Actions (CI/CD)

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience building and maintaining mobile apps in production environments
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development
  • Deep expertise in Flutter and/or React Native — you’ve shipped apps, solved performance issues, and know the ecosystems inside and out
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript
  • Strong product intuition and user-centric thinking
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative startup environment

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) and/or AWS
  • Experience with video hosting, real-time data, or automation workflows
  • Background in system design and mobile architecture at scale
  • Experience building SDKs or mobile frameworks for reuse across teams
  • Familiarity with Node.js and modern backend patterns (Nest.js experience is a plus)
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams and mentoring junior engineers
  • Comfort working in CI/CD environments and managing deployments
  • Experience working in a CRM or SaaS product company

What You'll Get

• Real ownership over your work and visibility into how it impacts users

• Collaboration with a sharp team across product, design, and leadership

• A fast-moving environment where ideas are welcomed and results matter

• Competitive salary: $2200 - $4000 (USD) Depending on experience

• Flexible Schedule

• English classes to support professional growth

• Team lunches and regular team-building activities

We're not hiring just to fill a seat. We're hiring someone who wants to make a difference, contribute at a high level, and help us scale with quality and clarity. If that sounds like you, let's talk.

Note:

  • This is a senior-level position that requires at least 5 years of hands-on experience building mobile applications and 7 years of professional software development experience.
  • If your background doesn't yet align with these requirements, we truly appreciate your interest, but this may not be the right fit at this time. We encourage you to check back in the future as our team continues to grow.
  • This is a contract (PJ) position with potential for growth. The role is hybrid, with 1–2 days/week expected in our Curitiba office and the rest remote. You must be available to work during US hours (MST) to ensure team alignment.

  • Atuar na criação, análise e reporte de indicadores estratégicos de Atração, Seleção e Talentos, elaborando relatórios gerenciais que assegurem a precisão, a relevância e a utilidade dos dados para a tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar parcerias com fornecedores e consultorias especializadas, implementando novas ferramentas e metodologias que garantam eficiência nos processos de seleção de candidatos externos e assegurem a entrega de serviços de qualidade, alinhados às necessidades da empresa;
  • Fazer a gestão da equipe de Atração e Seleção, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo das competências técnicas e comportamentais por meio de feedbacks estruturados, acompanhamento individualizado e estímulo à inovação. O objetivo é fortalecer a performance, aumentar o engajamento e fomentar um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e de alto desempenho;

  • Trabalhar em parceria com os clientes internos e diferentes áreas da empresa para entender suas necessidades e promover ações e entregas que gerem valor.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável pós graduação ou MBA;
  • Experiência em RH com ênfase em Atração e Seleção;
  • Experiência na criação de estratégias para atração de talentos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e softwares de RH;
  • Experiência com indicadores e métricas de Atração e Seleção;
  • Desejável conhecimento em estratégias de Employer Branding;
  • Experiência em Diversidade, equidade e inclusão;

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.

About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support , enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData’s data feeds effectively.

We expect East Coast work hours.

As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients’ investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have) ; excellent client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients’ questions).

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operação - CD
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF! Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate - Simulation
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We combine engineering excellence with innovative digital solutions to solve real-world infrastructure challenges. From port and terminal digital twins to cloud-based inspection tools and automated 3D reconstruction, we deliver high-impact, data-driven insights to clients across the globe. We are actively looking for a Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate to join our Sao Paulo office. As part of the Flexterm Group, the Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate will help build robust pipelines that power simulation workflows, Kafka-driven data ingestion, Databricks-based data transformation, and cloud-based delivery of inspection and 3D data to client platforms. This is a hybrid position and will require some in-office presence in our office in Sao Paulo, BR.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbors and rivers, as well as an innovator in transportation. For the 4th year in a row, Moffatt & Nichol is Ranked #1 in Engineering News-Record for Marine & Port Facilities in the U.S. Additionally, our firm consistently ranks in the Top 100 Pure Designers in the US and the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, North America, Latin America, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in several primary practice areas – ports and harbors; coastal, environmental and water resources; urban waterfronts and marinas; transportation, bridges and rail; inspection and rehabilitation; and energy.

Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Azure Cloud Infrastructure

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable environments using Azure (AKS, VMs, Functions, Blob Storage, App Services, etc.)
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep to deploy and maintain consistent cloud environments

CI/CD and Automation

  • Create automated CI/CD pipelines for data processing, simulation, and 3D asset workflows
  • Enable cross-team automation for simulation engineers, inspection groups, and digital twin platform developers

Kafka & Databricks Pipelines

  • Set up and manage Kafka-based data ingestion from external platforms.
  • Integrate with Databricks for real-time and batch processing of simulation data, crack detection outputs, and inspection datasets

Simulation & Twin Integration

  • Deploy and orchestrate compute-heavy simulation jobs in the cloud
  • Integrate simulation results into real-time digital twin systems, enabling actionable insights on equipment performance and operational planning

3D Reconstruction & Inspection Workflows

  • Automate cloud-based 3D model reconstruction from inspection datasets (e.g., point clouds, drone imagery, crack detection outputs)
  • Package and deliver reconstructed 3D models and annotated inspection results via secure client portals or custom viewers

Client-Facing Delivery & Collaboration

  • Build secure sharing mechanisms for inspection reports, simulation results, and 3D models
  • Ensure reliable, auditable delivery pipelines that meet client compliance and usability needs

Security, Monitoring, and Resilience

  • Implement best practices in cloud security, encryption, and access control
  • Monitor systems using Azure Monitor, ELK, or Prometheus/Grafana to ensure availability, scalability, and performance

Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree (Software or Computer Engineering)
  • 4-8 years of experience
  • Strong experience with Azure services: AKS, Blob, Functions, App Gateway, and Networking
  • Proficient with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration at scale
  • Proficient with CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins
  • Hands-on with Kafka, including configuration, message flows, and monitoring
  • Experienced in Databricks: notebooks, pipelines, Delta Lake, and cluster management
  • Proficient in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for automation
  • Skilled in infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree
  • Familiarity with computer vision pipelines, crack detection, or point cloud processing
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Installers (MSI)
  • Experience creating digitally signed application installers and collaborating with QA for deployment testing
  • Understanding REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and real-time data delivery
  • Prior experience supporting engineering or infrastructure-focused teams
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171
  • Moffatt & Nichol uses E-Verify and employment is contingent upon the legal ability to obtain employment in the U.S. and to present the required documentation at hire

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Testing and commissioning Engineer to join our dynamic team for Data Center projects in Brazil. This position demands a solid foundation in electrical engineering, particularly in testing and Commissioning power generation equipment. The ideal candidate will ensure that all equipment and systems adhere to Industry standards and regulatory requirements through thorough and safe testing processes. Responsibilities will encompass managing all aspects of testing, including Factory acceptance Tests (FAT), Site acceptance Tests (Sat), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). The engineer should be proficient in developing and executing test plans That align with customer needs while maintaining clear communication with the factory.

Key responsibilities:

  • Actual participation in testing and commissioning activities including FAT, SAT, and IST;
  • Ensure adherence to industry regulations and safety standards during testing and commissioning processes;
  • Develop and implement testing protocols to validate system functionality and performance according to customer specificity;
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to testing and commissioning;
  • Collaborate with project teams to incorporate testing and commissioning activities into overall project plans;
  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred;
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning power generator preferred;
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical testing and commissioning (E.g., IEEE, IEC, NEC);
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and capacity to analyze complex electrical systems;
  • Experience in project management or coordination is a plus;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team;
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality;
  • This position may require travel to project sites or customer locations, both locally and internationally as needed.

*Please note that this is a 1 year renewable contract position*

title: Key Account Manager
description:
ompany Overview:

Anker Innovations is a global leader in charging technology and a developer of consumer electronics and smart devices. We are committed to bringing innovative products to our customers and ensuring the highest standards of quality and service. As we expand our presence in Latam, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Channel Specialist to join our team

Key Responsibilities:

As a Channel Specialist, you will be the cornerstone of our channel expansion and management efforts in Brazil. Your core duties will include:

  • Project Coordination & Lead Management: Take ownership of the regional distributor recruitment project by collecting, organizing, and managing all distributor leads generated by our sales advisors.
  • Distributor Screening & Onboarding: Conduct preliminary screenings of potential distributors based on established criteria, proactively contact and qualify candidates in target regions, and build a structured pipeline. You will collaborate with our headquarters team to finalize the selection of new distributors.
  • Account Management & Growth: Manage and support the ongoing relationship with appointed regional distributors. This includes facilitating orders, managing procurement processes, monitoring sales targets, and ultimately being accountable for the sales performance and revenue growth within your channel.

Qualifications:

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven professional with:

  • Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience in sales, channel management, or key account management.
  • Industry Knowledge: Prior experience in the consumer electronics industry is highly preferred.
  • Cultural Affinity: Experience working with or for a Chinese company is a significant advantage.
  • Personal Attributes: A self-starter with a strong sense of initiative, excellent resilience under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for embracing change and challenges. You must be a quick learner who can rapidly apply new knowledge to your work.

We Offer:

  • A pivotal role in the expansion of a globally recognized and beloved brand.
  • A dynamic, fast-paced, and supportive international work environment.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: Business Analyst
description:
We are looking to hire a Order Management and Billing Analyst (Business Analyst)

In Sao Paulo, Brazil

The role of the Order Management and Billing Analyst (OBA) is to assist the sales force in submitting completely accurate order data, and to identify all elements of a transaction for analysis, manage the tasks of reviewing, inputting, and invoicing customer orders. OBA will process hardware, software, subscription, consulting, professional services, and maintenance orders. The OBA will use the tools and processes designed for order management and maintain compliance to all corporate policies involving order transactions. Ensure the sourcing of orders follow the expected shipment date as per business needs, communicate with hardware suppliers and delivery/logistic teams, support order management process in terms of invoicing based on invoice triggers in our ERP, and ensure all documentation is properly stored in the appropriate systems. The OBA will keep apprised of the status of cloud provisioning, and trigger invoicing per customer agreements and orders aligned to our corporate policies. The position requires outstanding organization and communication skills for the candidate to be successful.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

· Assist Sales Teams in securing proper order documentation for execution into systems

· Ensure system configuration and pricing on purchase order is consistent with contract.

· Review contract to determine all elements of the transaction. Add proper product IDs to order for any bundled items (Subscriptions, Hardware, Software, Services, etc.)

· Ensure all related orders are built in our systems / ERP for appropriate booking and invoicing.

· Execute the defined order process and conduct effective interaction with Sales teams, while maintaining compliance with corporate policy.

· Generate customer invoices for assigned accounts in an accurate and timely manner. Recognize the requirements for any special invoicing provisions in the customer contract and react accordingly.

· Review customer order documentation for order acceptance; ensure appropriate documentation is received and complies with corporate order and revenue policies.

· Assist in the resolution of relevant outstanding accounts receivable and collection issues.

· Read and analyze various customer contract provisions that impact the order process and invoicing requirements.

· Ensure purchase order is accurately reflected in system.

· Process Return Material Authorizations (RMA’s) within the SLA.

· Solve issues involving order processing. Provide outstanding order processing service to the account teams.

· Action and update tasks per SLA and procedures.

· Ensure the direct communication with all stakeholders, including customers, as needed, to ensure on-time delivery of services, hardware, software and invoices.

· Solve/coordinate issues to ensure the billing happens on time.

· Analyze trends in workflow to identify discrepancies and process improvement opportunities.

· Assist with audits to maintain our compliance.

Work Environment :

This position may require overtime at month ends, quarter closes and year-end. Weekend work maybe required depending on the timing of month ends.

Candidate Requirements:

· An exemplary level of ethics.

· Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to lead problem solving activity.

· The ability to manage stress without it negatively effecting work quality or professional demeanor.

· Knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel.

· Excellent organization skills and a high level of comfort handling details.

· Ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple tasks successfully in a fast-paced environment.

· Knowledge of, or the ability to learn, all order related software and system tools

· Excellent work attendance records and habits.

· Ability to think creatively and adapt well to change.

· Ability to read, analyze and understand customer contracts, corporate policies, and miscellaneous order documentation.

· English and Protuguese language are must.

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON:

title: Commercial Performance Specialist EMEA LATAM
description:

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION: Commercial Performance Specialist EMEA LATAM

LOCATION: Zona Sul, São Paulo, Brazil

JOB TYPE: Indeterminado

ROLE SENIORITY: Managerial

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

As part of the Commercial Excellence EMEA LATAM team, the Commercial Performance Specialist plays a key role in driving the execution and deployment of commercial excellence initiatives across the region to ensure sustainable business growth. This role acts as a strategic link between Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Service and Commercial Excellence, ensuring alignment between market dynamics and internal execution through clear dashboards, tools, and governance processes.

This role will focus on 3 key areas: price setup and profitability management, development of commercial policies (Commercial Policy), and sales contract optimization.

By enabling robust pricing processes, effective cross-selling, and stronger customer agreements, you will directly contribute to improved customer loyalty and long-term sustainable business continuity.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

1. Price Setup & Profitability Management

Centralize and harmonize price lists across country clusters and market segments.

Conduct profitability and business impact simulations to guide strategic pricing decisions.

Ensure process consistency, data accuracy and timely loading of prices in D365 (ERP).

Contribute to monitoring pricing effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.

2. Commercial Policy Development (Commercial Police)

Design, implement, and refine commercial policies to support cross-selling and upselling,

Leverage & analyze sell-out data to help commercial teams define customer based cross- and up-selling targets.

Identify and drive initiatives to improve gross-to-net performance in consistency with customer prioritization.

Partner with Sales, Marketing and Finance to align commercial policies with strategic objectives and optimize service level.

3. Sales Contracts & Terms Optimization

Collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Sales to develop and optimize sales contract terms and conditions to foster customer retention.

Ensure contracts balance commercial competitiveness with profitability, risk management and longer-term partnerships that reinforce business continuity.

Standardize and streamline contract processes.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Engineering, or related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Effectiveness, Business Analytics, or similar roles.
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI (or equivalent tools).
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Dynamics 365 preferred).
  • Knowledge of pricing, rebates, and Go-to-Market models.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish is a strong advantage.
  • Ability to work across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with strong business acumen.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • High level of ownership, autonomy, and accountability.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in a multicultural environment.

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em fase de expansão bem rápida, buscando A-players que vão nos ajudar a escalar e crescer com a gente.

Se tu quer uma oportunidade pra se destacar de verdade, com remuneração acima do padrão do mercado e chance real de aprendizado e evolução profissional, essa vaga é pra ti.

Trabalhamos com alguns dos principais nomes do mercado digital internacional — e esse é o perfil de cliente que vamos continuar buscando. Se tu te interessa por internet, marketing, negócios, conteúdo, criatividade e futuro, esse trabalho é especialmente interessante, pelo tanto que tu pode aprender consumindo (e ajudando a criar) o conteúdo dos nossos clientes.

Se tu é o tipo de pessoa que olha um conteúdo e pensa “eu faria melhor”, que quer trabalhar com os melhores e ser pago à altura — continua lendo.

Essa vaga NÃO é pra quem tá procurando:

→ Uma agência tradicional, cheia de burocracia e política

→ Uma cultura em que a gente, “deixa assim, porque já tá bom o suficiente”

→ Uma operação lenta e desorganizada

Se tu tá procurando "trabalho tranquilo das 9h às 17h" ou "ambiente corporativo estruturado", pode fechar essa aba agora.

Mas se tu quer:

→ Criar conteúdo para alguns dos maiores nomes do mercado digital internacional;

→ Ganhar acima da média do mercado (de verdade);

→ Trabalhar num ritmo onde "rápido e impecável" não são opostos;

Nós vamos nos dar bem.

Sobre a VPPA:

Somos uma agência de Social Media e Anúncios, especializada em criação de conteúdo, criativos e gestão de Instagram, YouTube e LinkedIn para clientes internacionais, no nicho de business e similares.

Somos uma operação 100% remota, com base no Brasil.

Nossa cultura e valores:

1. Excelência, Obsessão por Detalhes:

Entregamos tudo com um padrão altíssimo, sem espaço pra erros.

Seja um vídeo, um design ou uma legenda, cada pixel, palavra e ideia precisa ser impecável.

Somos "chatos" com qualidade, porque acreditamos que os detalhes fazem a diferença entre o bom e o excepcional.

2. Agilidade como Vantagem Competitiva.

Velocidade é nosso diferencial.

Recebeu uma solicitação?

Em poucas horas, entregamos algo que já surpreende o cliente.

Trabalhamos rápido, mas sem sacrificar a qualidade, porque acreditamos que agilidade é o que nos coloca na frente.

3. Criatividade com Propósito

Criamos conteúdos que não são só bonitos, mas também entregam valor real — informação que educa, engaja e converte.

Cada post ou vídeo é pensado pra impactar, viralizar e trazer resultados concretos, como leads pros nossos

clientes.

4. High Agency e Proatividade

Somos donos das nossas entregas.

Não esperamos instruções detalhadas pra agir — tomamos iniciativa, trazemos ideias novas e fazemos acontecer.

Quem trabalha na VPPA vê problemas como oportunidades e está sempre pronto pra liderar o próprio caminho

"If you're offered a seat on a rocket ship, you don't ask what seat. You just get on."

O que tu vai fazer no dia a dia:

Você será responsável por todo o processo de criação: desde a seleção dos clipes, edição dos vídeos, criação de legendas, análise de performance e, o mais importante, a criação de conteúdos que geram resultado.

  • Editar vídeos diários para redes sociais (serão postados no Instagram, Shorts, LinkedIn, etc.), focado em gerar resultados, viralização e engajamento.
  • Manter um ritmo acelerado: produzir múltiplos conteúdos por dia, com prazos curtos e alta qualidade, incluindo disponibilidade para ajustes rápidos baseados em feedback de clientes.
  • Colaborar na ideação de conteúdos, formatos e roteiros, criação de legendas e estratégias de conteúdo, otimizando para algoritmos de plataformas sociais e tendências atuais.
  • Organizar o calendário de conteúdo, Google Drive e Frame (onde armazenamos tudo), garantindo eficiência e adiantamento nas entregas.
  • Se você tem experiência com conteúdo em vídeo nas redes sociais, sabe identificar tendências antes de todo mundo e consegue transformar instinto criativo em processos replicáveis — você vai se dar muito bem aqui.

Exemplos de vídeos parecidos com o que buscamos:

Quem estou buscando:

  • Um canivete suíço criativo — alguém que pensa grande e executa rápido. Sabe transformar estratégia em conteúdo que gera resultado, e já fez isso em alto nível, com consistência.
  • Você domina os elementos que fazem o conteúdo performar bem: ganchos fortes, ritmo dinâmico, estrutura bem definida e visual clean. Consegue equilibrar o que está bombando no momento com o que faz sentido para a identidade da marca no longo prazo — e não tem medo de testar coisas novas.
  • Diferencial : Você já foi responsável por estratégia e produção de conteúdo antes — e tem resultados concretos para mostrar. Já produziu conteúdo em escala, e sabe explicar como fez isso.

Requisitos:

  • Proficiência com o Pacote Adobe — especialmente Premiere, After Effects e Photoshop.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escuta e escrita) — todo o conteúdo que criamos é em inglês, e toda a comunicação com os clientes é em inglês.
  • Portfólio demonstrando alta qualidade criativa e resultados — Mínimo de 2-3 anos em funções semelhantes é ideal.
  • Olhar afiado para design — Domina design gráfico com atenção extrema aos detalhes, especialmente em conteúdos visuais.
  • Você não é só criativo — você pensa de forma estratégica, analisa o que funciona e ajusta com base no que gera resultado real.
  • Lidar bem com múltiplos projetos — Sabe gerenciar prazos, manter cronogramas e ainda assim entregar qualidade mesmo sob pressão.
  • Muita atenção aos detalhes — Seja nas legendas ou nos elementos visuais, você se preocupa em fazer tudo com excelência, sem deixar nada passar.
  • Se comunicar de forma clara — Seja escrevendo, dando feedback ou apresentando resultados, você é objetivo, direto e fácil de trabalhar junto.
  • Ser adaptável — As plataformas mudam rápido, e você é curioso, flexível e se adapta com facilidade.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ritmo acelerado, com agilidade (ex.: entregar um produto de qualidade em poucas horas após uma solicitação).

Bônus:

Se já usa ferramentas de IA como Runway, Google VEO/Flow, Nano Banana, Sora, Claude, ChatGPT ou similares — é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração acima da média do mercado, a combinar, com base na demanda.
  • Trabalho 100% remoto: flexibilidade para trabalhar de qualquer lugar no Brasil (ou país com fuso semelhante).
  • Acesso compartilhado à diversas ferramentas de IA e criação de conteúdo;
  • Possibilidade de bônus por performance de posts e contas (a combinar).

Além do pagamento e das ferramentas, você vai trabalhar num ambiente leve, sem formalidade forçada, mas com seriedade no que importa.

Sempre que puder, vou compartilhar o que sei pra te ajudar a crescer mais rápido. Se tu for curioso(a) e quiser evoluir nesse meio, esse pode ser um ótimo lugar pra acelerar.

Como aplicar:

Se você leu até aqui, se interessou e acredita que essa vaga tem a ver com você, é só preencher o formulário aqui embaixo.

IMPORTANTE: As respostas no formulário devem ser preenchidas em INGLÊS — aplicações enviadas em Português serão automaticamente desqualificadas.

Se quiser fazer contato comigo diretamente, pode me mandar uma mensagem no:

E se você não for essa pessoa, mas conhece alguém que pode se interessar , manda essa vaga pra ela. Se ela te mencionar na candidatura e for a pessoa escolhida (e passar pelo período de teste), eu te envio R$500 , como forma de agradecimento pela indicação.

  1. Análise inicial da aplicação e portfólio .
  2. Uma ou duas entrevistas para alinhar expectativas e confirmar o fit com a nossa cultura.

title: Analista de Gente e Performance Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Gestão dos contratos de Estágio e Aprendizagem, sendo o ponto focal na relação com os integradores;

title: Programador web
description:
Estamos à procura de uma Pessoa Programadora Web!

Junte-se ao nosso time e seja a peça-chave para dar vida a experiências digitais incríveis, impulsionando a presença online da nossa empresa e criando um impacto real para nossos usuários.

Resumo do Cargo

Como Pessoa Programadora Web em nossa empresa, você será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções web de alta qualidade e performance, com foco especial na plataforma WordPress. Você atuará na linha de frente da criação e manutenção do nosso site institucional e portal de notícias, transformando necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades robustas. Sua expertise será crucial para gerenciar nosso fluxo de conteúdo digital e implementar soluções de publicidade, garantindo uma plataforma escalável, atualizada e eficiente.

Como Você Terá Sucesso Neste Cargo

Você terá sucesso ao:

  • Dominar o WordPress: Customizar temas, desenvolver plugins personalizados e gerenciar a arquitetura completa do WordPress para atender às necessidades específicas do negócio.
  • Otimizar a Gestão de Conteúdo: Implementar e manter um fluxo eficiente de publicação de notícias e materiais editoriais, garantindo interface intuitiva para a equipe de conteúdo.
  • Implementar Soluções de Publicidade: Integrar e gerenciar sistemas de anúncios e monetização, assegurando a correta veiculação e acompanhamento de campanhas publicitárias.
  • Ser Colaborativa e Comunicativa: Trabalhar de forma integrada com outras pessoas desenvolvedoras, designers, equipe de conteúdo e marketing, comunicando-se com clareza sobre prazos e requisitos técnicos.
  • Manter-se Constantemente Atualizada: Mostrar curiosidade e proatividade para aprender novas tecnologias e melhores práticas, trazendo inovação contínua para nossos projetos.

Como Este Cargo se Encaixa na Organização

Nossa equipe de tecnologia é o coração que impulsiona a inovação na empresa. Como Pessoa Programadora Web especializada em WordPress, você será fundamental para nossa estratégia de comunicação digital e presença online. Seu trabalho irá sustentar diretamente nossos canais de notícias e iniciativas de marketing, impactando milhares de usuários diariamente e contribuindo para os objetivos de negócio através da publicidade digital. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo onde cada contribuição é valorizada e onde você terá a oportunidade de crescer profissionalmente junto conosco.

Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter sites em WordPress, incluindo customização de temas e desenvolvimento de plugins personalizados.
  • Gerenciar a estrutura e o fluxo de publicação de notícias, criando e otimizando taxonomias, campos personalizados e tipos de conteúdo.
  • Implementar e integrar soluções de publicidade no site, incluindo gestão de espaços publicitários, inserção de códigos de terceiros e configuração de ads.txt.
  • Garantir a performance, segurança e SEO dos sites em WordPress, realizando otimizações técnicas regulares.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing e conteúdo para implementar novas funcionalidades e layouts para notícias e seções especiais.
  • Realizar a manutenção e atualização de plugins e do core do WordPress, garantindo a estabilidade do ambiente.
  • Desenvolver e manter a integração do WordPress com outros sistemas da empresa através de APIs REST.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica sobre a estrutura e funcionamento do site.
Qualificações

Competências e Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento WordPress, incluindo criação de temas e plugins personalizados.
  • Domínio de HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript e PHP.
  • Experiência com gestão de conteúdo em WordPress, incluindo Custom Post Types, Taxonomias e Campos Personalizados (ACF ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em implementação e gestão de publicidade digital (ex: Google Ad Manager, ads.txt, header bidding).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão, como Git.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, com metodologias como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Forte habilidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de colaborar efetivamente em equipe.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas, ou experiência equivalente.

Será um Diferencial:

  • Experiência com otimização de performance em WordPress.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações WordPress.
  • Experiência com e-commerce WordPress (WooCommerce).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para ambientes WordPress.
  • Portfólio com exemplos de projetos WordPress desenvolvidos.

title: Merchant Onboarding Analyst (Shift Position)
description:
About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arabic world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more: Keeta website.

What you'll Do :

1. Review documents and information provided by merchants to ensure accuracy before the store goes live.

2. Upload and verify merchant account details, ensuring all information is complete, correct, and efficiently processed.

3. Check merchant qualifications according to company rules.

4. Review other applications submitted by business colleagues or merchants.

5. Organize and manage store photo-taking services.

6. Work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including night shifts and weekends.

7. Collaborate with Operations, Product, and other relevant teams to support merchant onboarding and resolve related issues.

What we need from You :

1. Responsible and reliable, willing to work hard to achieve team goals.

2. Eager to learn, open to new things, and able to adapt to changes.

3. Good communication skills, a team player, and willing to grow together with others.

4. Portuguese speaker, fluent in both spoken and written Portuguese. sales support is a plus (training will be provided).

5. Willing and able to work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including shift weekends. 6. Able to work efficiently under pressure, especially during peak periods, and handle handovers and transitions between teams smoothly.

7. Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail in managing shift tasks and onboarding processes.

What makes this role excinting :

1.Take part in the rapid growth of Meituan's global delivery business, work with an international team, and enjoy plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

2.Friendly and supportive team environment, where helps each other and grows together. Fun and relaxed atmosphere with everyone clear career development paths.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.
